decision_rule: Same as rounds 3-4. fwt_fort_worth_verdict: INFERRED. No page states the Kenn site's address in so many words, and nothing discriminates between Sabre's Fort Worth sites. Sabre's own UKG Ready board (221 requisitions, read 2026-11-13) files all 25 Fort Worth requisitions under '5750 I-20, Fort Worth 76119', whatever the site code: Kenn, Kenn-Inventory, 36th (e.g. 'Longseamer B - 36th (Nights)', 'EHS Manager- 36th'), AlvU ('Program Manager - AlvU') and uncoded. No requisition text names a street. EPA FRS lists separate Sabre sites in Fort Worth at 2400 NE 36th St (SABRE COMMUNICATIONS CORP) and 2300 W Risinger Rd (SABRE TUBULAR STRUCTURES), as well as SABRE-FWT at 5750 E. Interstate 20. Supporting evidence that does not settle it: EPA 'FWT INC EXPANSION' in Kennedale, about 330 m from the 5750 record; the template of a Marshall 'Sr Supervisor - MarU' requisition names 'the Kennedale, Texas Sabre Tubular Structures Manufacturing Facility' (no street). 'Kenn = Kennedale = 5750 E I-20' is a reasonable reading, not a statement. Under the precedent that inferred-attribution postings earn no points, process 20 -> 0 and labor 20 -> 0, giving a total of 61 -> 21 (Low) and confidence 2 -> 0. 13 FWT rows are corrected: 12 stated rows retagged inferred or with the Kenn clause removed, plus inferred row 3316, which carries a Tallo date found on no cited page. Sources that could settle it were unreachable: fastdol OSHA establishment pages (HTTP 402; a search summary, not quotable, describes a Kennedale establishment at 5750 East Interstate 20), the OSHA establishment search (405), TDLR TABS (503, maintenance) and sabreindustries.com location pages (403).

method: All 139 stated rows with a source URL for the 9 plants, plus the 10 address rows of the 6 address plants, were fetched with tools/fetch_page.py on 2026-11-13 (plain, with a headless-browser fallback).
